Realm-local initialization and byte buffers do not introduce a JavaScript DOM or alternate native allocator. Focused owner tests and native Node/Chromium Worker/main-realm probes cover dependency initialization, actual attribute child trees, shared namespaces, text coalescing, clone document ownership and XML IO. Original complete CXPathAPI/CXPathObject/CNodeList owners use the pinned native libxml2 XPath engine, generated SDK contracts, actual document identity and shared native result lifetime. Namespace insertion is first-wins, evaluation copies namespace/extension references and global generic-error reset remains at its original source location. Source domtest testXXPathAPI/testXXPathObject assertions run through the production context/service manager; actual Chromium main and DOM-free Worker evaluate/count/select with identical native root identity. Compiler-generated C accessors and bounded varargs formatting expose actual native fields, not guessed layouts or an alternate XPath evaluator. Native allocation-failure/undefined inputs/float-to-integer overflow, successful custom extension results, native shared-memory concurrency, real URI providers, metadata and full DOCX/XLSX shell/UI remain unqualified. Unmodified pinned libxml2 source/archive/compiler/configuration; no download or host numeric/XML provider. C long is the actual unsigned32 target value, explicitly lowered to sal_uInt32 bits by its caller. Actual native artifact now exports genuine pinned Emscripten libc strtoul and xmlEntity content accessors:157exports/851header enum constants. Existing XML bootstrap/getter delegates to this owner while retaining its original uninitialized diagnostic, native XML exports and byte-marshalling/lifetime.
